agent_response.summary: Prepared candidate 2: removed the final noise covariance solve using the existing adjoint weights. Restored baseline imports after candidate 1 showed no measured gain.
agent_response.hypothesis: The equivalent contraction Re(wᴴNw), where Aᴴw=d, may reduce solve and differentiation costs while preserving physics.
agent_response.notes: Candidate 1 fully validated with identical arrays but took 36.996298 s versus baseline median 35.737065 s. Candidate 2 passed syntax, diff checks and independent complex-algebra checks; official numerical validation remains pending. One detector provides no multi-RHS grouping opportunity; compiled factorization reuse remains unverified. Detailed evidence and required full-array comparisons are recorded in experiments/notes/initial-agent.md.
